name: Urgent transfers described as emergency family or legal payments
description: Customer receives or sends sudden large transfers framed as emergencies, to unfamiliar parties or accounts abroad.
fp: Genuine medical and legal emergencies produce similar urgency.

sources.text: FATF, Organised Maritime Piracy and Related Kidnapping for Ransom (2011)
UN Security Council Resolution 2133 (2014) on kidnapping for ransom by terrorist groups
